senses.gloss:
ITA-3.1.8 ṣaḍaṅgam षडङ्गम्
The six anatomical areas of the body
The six sections of the body comprise the four limbs, the trunk, and the head and neck region.

ITA-1.9.3.3.17 ṣaḍripuḥ षड्रिपुः
Six internal enemies
Six mental attributes or inner faults that lead to bondage of the soul, namely: desire, anger, greed, delusion, arrogance and jealousy.

ITA-4.7.3 ṣaḍvidhaparīkṣā षड्विधपरीक्षा
Six ways of clinical examination
Examination of a patient based on analysis of information acquired by the physician using his or her five senses and by interview.

ITA-9.1.42 ṣaḍvidhopakramāḥ षड्विधोपक्रमाः
Six types of treatment modalities
A subdividing of therapeutic measures into six categories: br̥ ṁhaṇam, snehanam, stambhanam, laṁghanaṁ, svedanam and rūkṣaṇaṁ.

ITA-8.3.40 ṣāḍavaḥ षाडवः
Confectionery
Various type of preparations made of sweet, sour, and salty substances.
